files.views/res_bank_views.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo>

    <record id="view_partner_bank_form_inherit_account" model="ir.ui.view">
        <field name="name">res.partner.bank.form.inherit</field>
        <field name="model">res.partner.bank</field>
        <field name="inherit_id" ref="base.view_partner_bank_form"/>
        <field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//page[@name='internal_notes']" position="before">
                <field name="display_qr_setting" invisible="1" />
                <page string="Payment QR Settings" name="emv_qr_settings" invisible="not display_qr_setting or not company_qr_code">
                    <group>
                        <field name="country_proxy_keys" invisible="1"/>
                        <field name="proxy_type" widget="dynamic_selection" options="{'available_field': 'country_proxy_keys'}"/>
                        <field name="proxy_value"/>
                        <field name="include_reference"/>
                    </group>
                </page>
            </xpath>
        </field>
    </record>

</odoo>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<odoo auto_sequence="1">

    <record id="form_01_gtgt_report" model="account.report">
        <field name="name">Form 01/GTGT</field>
        <field name="name@vi_VN">Tờ khai thuế GTGT khấu trừ 01/GTGT</field>
        <field name="country_id" ref="base.vn"/>
        <field name="search_bar" eval="False"/>
        <field name="root_report_id" ref="account.generic_tax_report"/>
        <field name="load_more_limit" eval="80"/>
        <field name="default_opening_date_filter">this_month</field>
        <field name="filter_date_range" eval="True"/>
        <field name="filter_unfold_all" eval="False"/>
        <field name="filter_growth_comparison" eval="False"/>
        <field name="filter_period_comparison" eval="False"/>
        <field name="filter_journals" eval="False"/>
        <field name="filter_partner" eval="False"/>
        <field name="filter_show_draft" eval="True"/>
        <field name="filter_unreconciled" eval="True"/>
        <field name="filter_multi_company">selector</field>
        <field name="column_ids">
            <record id="purchase_tax_report_invoice_number" model="account.report.column">
                <field name="name">Code</field>
                <field name="name@vi_VN">Mã</field>
                <field name="expression_label">code_1</field>
                <field name="figure_type">string</field>
            </record>
            <record id="purchase_tax_report_invoice_date" model="account.report.column">
                <field name="name">Untaxed Amount</field>
                <field name="name@vi_VN">Giá trị chưa thuế</field>
                <field name="expression_label">amount_untaxed</field>
                <field name="figure_type">monetary</field>
            </record>
            <record id="purchase_tax_report_partner_id" model="account.report.column">
                <field name="name">Code</field>
                <field name="name@vi_VN">Mã</field>
                <field name="expression_label">code_2</field>
                <field name="figure_type">string</field>
            </record>
            <record id="purchase_tax_report_tax_id" model="account.report.column">
                <field name="name">VAT Amount</field>
                <field name="name@vi_VN">Thuế GTGT</field>
                <field name="expression_label">balance</field>
                <field name="figure_type">monetary</field>
            </record>
        </field>
        <field name="line_ids">
            <record id="form_01_gtgt_report_A" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">A. No transactions occurred within the period (marked "X")</field>
                <field name="name@vi_VN">A. Không phát sinh hoạt động mua, bán trong kỳ (đánh dấu "X")</field>
                <field name="code">21</field>
                <field name="hierarchy_level">0</field>
                <field name="expression_ids">
                    <record id="form_01_gtgt_report_A_code_1" model="account.report.expression">
                        <field name="label">code_1</field>
                        <field name="engine">text</field>
                        <field name="formula">[21]</field>
                    </record>
                </field>
            </record>
            <record id="form_01_gtgt_report_B" model="account.report.line">
                <field name="name">B. Deductible VAT carried forward from the previous period</field>
